overview: Some of Hollywood's biggest stars reveal their journeys to game-changing leading roles. In candid interviews, they shine a light on the highs and lows of their craft, breakthrough moments, blueprints for success, and the next generation's huge potential.
title: Number One on the Call Sheet

overview: A struggling single mom rallies her quirky family to outsmart a mafia boss after her estranged, wealthy father dies, leaving them with massive debt.
title: Bienvenidos a la familia

overview: News for children.
title: Telesylw

overview: In the haunted heart of New Orleans, Coven Academy follows three teenage witches and their dangerously charming warlock peers at an elite magic boarding school where power is currency, secrets are lethal and attraction is a liability. Caught between ancient supernatural wars and forbidden love interests, the coven must decide how far they're willing to go to protect their city—and themselves.
title: Coven Academy

overview: Street Art Challenge brings artists from different cities together for unique assignments: to blend their styles and perspectives into a new work of street art.
title: Street Art Challenge

overview: Lyu Shao and Li Dun were once lovers, but fate had other plans—one became a consort, and the other a prince. Unable to attain Lyu Shao's love, Li Dun grew resentful, especially since her brother, Lyu Xun, was his romantic rival. After ascending the throne, his love for Lyu Shao twisted into cruelty. Determined to escape Li Dun's grasp, Lyu Shao devised a plan to flee. However, on her way, she encountered Consort Wenzhao. During their confrontation, a bolt of lightning struck them, and when they awoke, they had swapped bodies. As Li Dun began to notice unusual changes in Wenzhao's behavior, the real Wenzhao, now inhabiting Lyu Shao's body, realized she had unexpectedly risen to the position of Empress Dowager. Ambitious and power-hungry, she used Lyu Xun's love for his sister and her newfound authority to repeatedly try to eliminate Lyu Shao. Yet each time, Lyu Shao fought back. When Li Dun finally uncovered the truth about the body swap, Lyu Shao pleaded for her freedom. But unwilling to let her go, Li Dun imprisoned her once more—committing an irreversible mistake in the process.
title: The Duel of Hearts

overview: Afonya is a brownie with experience, accustomed to life in the old Khrushchev, where everyone knows each other. But now he's being moved to a modern apartment complex where people don't even greet their neighbors. Together with his longtime friend Semenych, a former pediatrician, he decides to restore order – grandpa gets a job as a concierge, and Afonya takes the situation into her (magical) hands. But will they be able to bring comfort and harmony to a house where some make noise at night, others hide behind gadgets, and others do not believe in brownies at all? There is a lot of humor, magic and unpredictable adventures in the new comedy series!
title: Афоня

overview: Death At The White Hart is set in the Dorset village of Fleetcombe, where the village pub's landlord is found murdered. Detective Nicola Bridge must unpick a web of lies and rivalries to unmask the killer.
title: Death At The White Hart

overview: Katagiri Mirei has been constantly bullied due to her appearance. She decides to take the opportunity to undergo plastic surgery and obtain a beautiful face before entering college. During the school orientation, Mirei receives multiple compliments on her appearance from her classmates, while she is confused, she is secretly elated. However, her joy is short-lived when an incident leads to everyone discovering that she has done plastic surgery. At the same time, Mirei reunites with Sakaguchi Kei, a handsome classmate from her middle school.
title: Beauty Newbie
Zhidao Woshi Zongcai Ni Zengmo Houhuile

overview: In The Visioneers with Zay Harding The Visioneers will take viewers around the world as it showcases the scientists, engineers, and everyday people who are creating environmental solutions.
title: The Visioneers with Zay Harding

overview: Rewi Spraggon enlists six of the best chefs in Aotearoa and gets them to add their expertise, tastes and techniques to a traditional Māori hāngī under the gaze of thousands at one of the biggest food shows in Aotearoa, Taste of Auckland.
title: Hangi Pit Masters

overview: Psychological studies have found that repeating an action for twenty-one consecutive days can help change a person's behaviour, such as waking up early or exercising. The idea, extended to matters of love, evolves into the 21-Day Theory: the belief that if you pursue someone for twenty-one consecutive days, you'll win their heart. But what happens when a woman uses the 21-Day Theory in an attempt to turn a gay man straight? A woman has had a crush on a wealthy and seemingly perfect man who's remained single for a long time. Rumors swirl about his sexual orientation, but she refuses to believe them. He never confirms or denies the speculation that he's gay. Determined to uncover the truth for herself, she employs the theory to pursue him.
title: Club Friday Theory of Love: The 21-Day

overview: Puppet series introduced by OIwen Rees
title: Llon a Llwyd

overview: Wildlife quiz
title: Bam-bw!

overview: Comedy Central Presents is the network's main half-hour program which highlights either one or a series of stand-up comedians each episode.
title: Comedy Central Presents

overview: Middle school teacher Zhao Xingrou and the warlord marshal Yi Qiuting fall in love, but their love is thwarted by differences in family backgrounds. Yi Qiuting's tough tactics even leads to misaligned affection in their relationship. When she thinks she has lost her child, Zhao Xingrou fakes her death and leaves. Many years later, she makes a comeback and proves with her actions that women can live a glorious life independently.
title: Blazing Elegance

overview: Stephanie's Places follows WWE icon Stephanie McMahon as she explores the pockets of America that helped shape the journeys of some of the most famous names in WWE history.
title: Stephanie's Places

overview: Witch Matriarch Xia Mo is bound by a deadly curse after losing her necklace. Desperate to reclaim it, she strikes a dangerous bargain with Mu Hanyu, a vengeful physics professor and vows to fulfill his wish. By frequent contact, they gradually fall in love. However, fate pits them against each other...
title: The Secret Contract of the Witch

overview: Dreamers follows an eclectic group of dance students as they navigate the intense highs and lows of coming of age in today's complex world – captured through stories which are as joyful and funny as they are raw and truthful, brought viscerally to life via irresistible dance choreography.
title: Dreamers

overview: On the 20th anniversary of National Geographic's Academy Award®-winning "March of the Penguins," SECRETS OF THE PENGUINS changes everything we ever believed to be true. From the emperor penguins' revelatory bonds of friendship to the gritty resolve of gentoos and rockhoppers and the astonishing ingenuity of the migrant penguins that reached deserts and far beyond, their incredible traditions and societies echo ours in ways we never dreamt possible — until now. For over two years, BAFTA and Emmy® Award-winning wildlife cinematographer Bertie Gregory has collaborated with world-leading scientists, using cutting-edge camera technology and unique access to capture three world-first episodes that resonate with our lives like never before.
title: Secrets of the Penguins

overview: Get ready to hit the high seas with Love Overboard! Step aboard the ultimate luxury yacht, where sexy singles are ready to mix and mingle … and find love. But there's a twist … gaining access to the yacht's extravagant amenities won't be so simple. As the journey unfolds, romance ignites; alliances form; and hearts are shattered. In the end, only one couple will reign supreme. Who will rise to the top, and who will be left stranded?
title: Love Overboard

overview: Host, Jhone Lucas, takes The Gen Zone team around the country documenting the race to the White House providing a Gen Z perspective on the Presidential campaigns of Kamala Harris/Tim Walz and Donald Trump/JD Vance.
title: The Gen Zone

overview: Marcello, a mysterious patient with no memory, in hospital for over a year. Elena, a passionate neuropsychiatrist searching for the person responsible for her husband's death. When these two lives intersect, it doesn't happen by chance. Maybe these two lives have something that connects them.
title: Se potessi dirti Addio

overview: Shim Gun Wook plots revenge against the Haeshin Group, a large corporation to whom Hong Tae Sung is the heir.
title: Bad Boy

overview: To save her late fiance Tang Jingxing's struggling Chinese jewelry brand, Mi Chuxia teams up with celebrity influencer Lu Yi. As they work together to revive the company, sparks of romance begin to fly. But when Chuxia discovers Lu Yi's true identity as Tang Jingxing himself, she must confront the shocking truth behind his presumed death in a car crash three years earlier.
title: Marry Me Again

overview: The Future of Nature takes a rare look at the vital role of carbon in our planet, and the power of nature in helping to restore and stabilize our ecosystems.
title: The Future of Nature

overview: Urvi Went To An All Girls School is a coming-of-age comedy about one teen girl's survival, with disastrous and hilarious consequences. Urvi is an awkward, unpopular 16-year-old girl entering Year 11, at the painfully academic, selective public school Grogan Girls High. She desperately wants to become a famous actress, and dreams of being noticed by Hot Ryan, the hottest Year 12 at Grogan Boys. Urvi's school year looks doomed. Her little sister Maya has skipped a grade and joined forces with Urvi's school bullies, her parents want her to become a doctor and the only boy she knows is her dad. That is until a Grogan Girls alumni turned soap actress named Sophie turns up out of the blue to direct the Grogan Girls and Boys combined school musical. Urvi finally sees a path to stardom - and sacrifices her other subjects (and her sanity) to pursue her dream.
title: Urvi Went To An All Girls School

overview: Westerners follows three young diaspora adults navigating the chaos of life in Western Sydney, where even the simplest tasks spiral into the surreal. Jackie, a struggling artist, makes a deal with the Devil to cure her creative block. Taz must choose between living with share house mould or even worse: moving back in with her parents. Dulla can't walk down the street without being chased by a horde of women who all want to play matchmaker. Between existential crises and absurd misadventures, they're just trying to live their version of an ordinary life.
title: Westerners

overview: It's often said that the people who can inflict the most harm upon you are the ones closest to you. This is the story of a single mother whose world revolves around her son, her closest companion. As the weight of responsibilities become overwhelming, she goes looking for love, hoping to create a fresh start for her family and mend her weary heart. The new man in her life seamlessly becomes a part of the family, effortlessly meeting all the criteria she had set for him. "Love her and, more importantly, love her son" was the foremost requirement, and he fulfilled it admirably. Despite their deep bond, she had always believed there had been a gap she couldn't bridge. Now, her son has a role model in his life. They spend time together, engaging in typical father-son activities like watching and playing football and their blooming relationship fills her with warmth. However, she remains unaware of the true nature of the bond between her son and his stepfather. When the truth comes to light, she'll face a heart-wrenching decision.
title: Club Friday Hot Love Issue: Domestic Incident

overview: Roger De Courcey and Nookie the Bear star in this children's comedy series.
title: Now for Nookie

overview: Jim Rockford is an ex-con-turned-private-investigator who would rather fish than fight, but whose instinct on closed cases is more golden than his classic Pontiac Firebird. From his mobile home in Malibu, this wisecracking private eye takes on the cases of the lost and the dispossessed, chasing down seemingly long-dead clues in the sun-baked streets and seamy alleys of Los Angeles.
title: The Rockford Files

overview: "Evening Quarter" - a project of the studio "Quarter 95" in the format of intellectual humor. In this big concert show, politicians and athletes, musicians and TV stars are laughed at kindly and wholeheartedly, and often together with them.
title: Вечерний квартал

overview: Trouble at the UK's biggest water company. Behind the headlines to witness the business's fight for survival - and the teams on the front line trying to keep things flowing.
title: Thames Water: Inside the Crisis

overview: Stranded after their bus breaks down, students must survive in the woods as days pass without rescue. As mysterious events occur, they race to uncover the truth behind their driver's disappearance.
title: Rouge forêt

overview: The Death Coast is an area of rough sea in the North Atlantic that's claimed more than six thousand vessels across centuries. Many sailors braved these waters – some for trade, some for war, and some for plunder. Gold and priceless objects from their wrecked ships now lie scattered across the ocean floor but salvaging has been banned here for the last decade. Now, after a long battle, shipwreck hunter Jeff Mackinnon has won exclusive rights to dive. He and his team have just 12 weeks to search the wrecks before the turbulent waters of the Death Coast make diving impossible.
title: The Death Coast

overview: Anya and Masha Gorbachev are sisters by their father, whom they have never seen. Fate brings them together in the same investigative department, where Anya serves as an investigator and Masha as an operative. They have different personalities and different approaches to work. But eternal contradictions and irreconcilable differences will be the key to the success of this couple, who will have to solve more than one crime together.
title: Дуплет

overview: Creepy Bits is a 10-episode chilling horror collection that delves deeper into the unknown, drawing inspiration from contemporary issues and venturing into uncharted territories of fear. Each episode is helmed by a diverse range of innovative filmmakers, including Ashlea Wessel, Adrian Bobb, Kelly Paoli, Sid Zanforlin, and creator David J. Fernandes. The series explores themes of human vs. nature, the invasion and destruction of the natural world, and isolation within a vast, eerie landscape that fights back. From the depths of the forest to the darkness of the lake, to quaint small towns, each episode promises to unsettle and disturb.
title: Creepy Bits

overview: Country music is exploding in popularity in Britain and music fan Rob Brydon, who once topped the charts with his own take on a country classic (Barry) Islands in the Stream, with Gavin and Stacey co-star Ruth Jones, is hitting the road on a round trip of America's southern states in search of the people, places and culture where country music roots run deep. He'll be meeting the stars, hanging out with locals and immersing himself in the way of life. It's an entertaining, fascinating and laughter filled exploration of country music, past and present, during which Rob discovers its origins, the secrets to its longevity and what led to its recent global explosion all set against the epic backdrop of the American south.
title: Rob Brydon's Honky Tonk Road Trip

overview: The Forsytes chronicles the lives, loves, trials and triumphs of a wealthy late Victorian stockbroking family, whose generations are torn between the tradition and self-sacrifice versus personal happiness and the pursuit of love. Family stability is threatened by two chance encounters for rival cousins, Jolyon and Soames, throwing their previously steady lives into disarray.
title: The Forsytes

overview: Based in the 1930's of Shanghai, China, this drama is a story about love, friendship, patriotism and desire. Shin Jung Tae is an outrageous and clumsy man, but has an unconditional love for his country and family. He was known as one of the best fighter in the alleys of Shanghai.
title: Inspiring Generation

overview: In Seven Sisters, a large, tightknit family begins to unravel when a sister starts communicating with a voice no one else can hear — forcing each of them to confront long-buried secrets.
title: Seven Sisters

overview: In the new Prison Break: Black Creek, a soldier-turned-corrections officer takes a job at one of the deadliest prisons in America to prove just how far she'll go for someone she loves.
title: Prison Break: Black Creek

overview: In their past lives, the Empress and the Imperial Consort locked in fierce rivalry. Their untimely deaths then revealed the bitter truth: they were nothing but pawns, discarded by the Emperor. Reborn, the Empress returns to the very day the Emperor falsely accused the Consort and caused the death of her unborn royal child. This time, she does everything she can to protect her former enemy. However, she finds out that the Consort has been reborn too! With their identities confirmed, the two sworn enemies become allies, determined to drag the unfaithful Emperor down from his throne.
title: Phoenix Alliance
Wu You Wu Lv Cheng Zhang Ji

overview: Pei Yan Yan and Gao Song fell in love in high school but broke up before they graduated college. As time passes, the two are brought back together through their careers 7 years later. Gao Song is now a university teacher and cybersecurity expert, while Yan Yan is a media reporter. Gao Song begins to realize he is still in love with Yan Yan and decides to break up with his girlfriend in an attempt to pursue Yan Yan again. Love and hate are two sides of the same coin. They both harbor resentment and love. Yan Yan turns a blind eye until Gao Song encounters a life-staking crisis. Only then does Yan Yan begin to admit her true emotions.
title: Bound at First Sight

overview: #Somebody's Son, a one-of-a-kind dating journey in the world of Black love, romance and family. The series is derived from the popular hashtag (#SomebodysSon) that celebrates the search for Black love, bringing the online sensation to life on screen. It follows three charming, single and successful men as they embark on a high stakes search for true love, looking for a lasting partner amongst a group of exceptional single women. But there's someone extra along for the ride -- each of their mothers will be joining them on this adventure, offering guidance, support and a little drama as they help (or attempt to help) their sons find the one. Through competitive challenges, bonding activities and heartfelt moments, the moms play a pivotal and sometimes divisive role in determining if mother truly knows best when it comes to matters of the heart.
title: #Somebody's Son

overview: Richard Hammond and James May look back at nostalgic clips of The Grand Tour.
title: The Not Very Grand Tour

overview: Second World War series exploring the desperate struggle for survival on a hostile ocean.
title: The Battle of the Atlantic

overview: Україна має талант (Ukraine Got Talent) is a talent show on Ukrainian TV channel STB, launched in 2009. Is an analogue of the American TV show Simon Cowell "In America there is talent" (America's Got Talent). Filming of the first season took place in 2009 in six large on TV STB 3 on April 2009 goda (casting in Odessa). Top: Oksana Marchenko (seasons 1-6), Dmitry Tankovic and Konstantin Tomilchenko (Season 7). Referees: Vladislav Yama (seasons 1-5), Slava Frolova, Igor Kondratyuk, Vyacheslav Uzelkov, Hector Jimenez-Bravo (season 6). From the 4th season, viewers saw a change: in episodes of casting, and in the Live show has involved two stages for performances. The first - for classical performances, and the second - for extreme genres (parkour motokrossing and so on. D.), Which requires a large area and the possibility of additional cumbersome equipment.
title: Україна має талант

overview: Western Algarve, 1943. In the midst of World War II, Portugal declares neutrality, but in the isolated village of Aljezur, the reality is different. German air raids on Allied ships off the coast spread fear among the population, still marked by a history of witchcraft. Celeste, a young orphan from a heretical family, is accused of being the heir to this evil that caused so many past tragedies. Betrayed and expelled from the village, she sets out in search of the truth about her parents' death, her identity and revenge against those who condemned her. Meanwhile, the growing Nazi presence in the region hides dark secrets. A story of mystery, superstition and resistance to oppression, which questions the very malleable nature of truth.
title: Finisterra

overview: A working-class African-American father of five relocates his family from Detroit to Los Angeles after the death of his wife.
title: Harris and Company

overview: A group of celebrities roam a spectacular mansion challenging each other in a psychological game that involves constant teamwork to complete missions and accumulate a cash prize. But hidden among the contestants are traitors who will try to deceive and manipulate the rest of the group to grab the ultimate prize for themselves alone, while the others, unaware of who the traitors are, work as a team with the aim of eliminating them from the game. The stakes will be high and will test everyone's ability to juggle a dense web of alliances and betrayals. If at least one traitor makes it to the end of the game he will keep the entire prize money for himself, but if all the traitors are unmasked, the other participants still in the game can divide the prize equally.
title: The Traitors Italia

overview: Every summer, the Total 24 Hours of Spa GT3 race is held in Belgium. This series goes behind the scenes with the drivers and pit crews fighting for victory.
title: Endurance: 24 hours at Spa

overview: A gripping docuseries chronicling the attempted arrest of notorious drug lord Ovidio Guzmán, son of "El Chapo," and the tragic violence that ensued.
title: Culiacanazo Herederos del Narco

overview: Pristine waters, exotic ports of call and unique, once-in-a-lifetime activities await you on Dream Cruises. Sail away with us on state of the art vessels fit for adventure on the seas.
title: Dream Cruises

overview: A young sprinter, Siya, is given a life-changing scholarship to a prestigious school in Johannesburg. While racing toward his dreams of athletic success, he must also outrun the trauma and painful memories that haunt him, learning that the real race is not only on the track but also within himself.
title: Go!

overview: To avenge her mother's death, Wan Lin goes undercover for three years, posing as the fiancée of Fu Yan, heir to the underworld empire in Mai City. But on their wedding day, during a raid led by her own agency, Wan Lin shoots Fu Yan. When they meet again, enemies become allies. As Wan Lin begins to see the sincerity in Fu Yan's heart. Together, they dismantle the criminal forces from within. Vengeance eventually gives way to love, and the two step into a new life, hand in hand.
title: Hunting Love

overview: They're young and serious about love — meet the singles looking to marry. With the MCs' help, couples hope to find a lifelong partnership.
title: Heart Pairing

overview: Where will my suppressed feelings finally burst out go? A romance of unrequited love with different dreams that will lead nowhere!
title: Something Is Not Right

overview: La cacería is inspired by shocking police cases that have shaken public opinion in Chile, with the aim of reflecting on these, looking backwards from today. On each season, the former detective César Rojas (Francisco Melo) deals with stucked unresolved cases due to authorities' negligence.
title: La cacería

overview: Kim Minjun is your average 30-year-old office worker. Now that he's older, Minjun is feeling the pressure to accomplish more in life, and he can't shake the feeling that something is missing amidst the monotonous routine of his 9-to-5 job. Out of nowhere, his ex-boyfriend Jinhwan shows up as a new co-worker, looking as handsome and charismatic as ever while Minjun feels like he hasn't progressed at all since their breakup 10 years ago. Determined not to let an ex from a decade ago mess with his work life, Minjun just wants to carry on with business as usual. But it seems that Jinhwan has other plans in mind…
title: Business as Unusual

overview: Each year in Israel, two million people dial 101 to receive an emergency medical service. More than 5000 calls a day are received at the MDA call centers throughout the country. The series "Ambulance" follows the medical teams through their critical moments, their breaking points and their moments of happiness.
title: Ambulance
From a Cult Leader to a Beloved Wife

overview: Vizinhos para Sempre portrays the lives of the residents of Terraços do Glamour, a recent and poorly built condominium. The series explores tense and fun relationships, between connections, such as absurd disputes, impossible loves and unexpected alliances; and has as its backdrop the housing crisis and typical neighborhood conflicts. All this with an irreverent and current humor.
title: Vizinhos para Sempre

overview: The Alternative Comedy Experience is a stand-up comedy show that premiered on 5 February 2013 on the Comedy Central channel in the UK. It features live comedy shows, filmed in July 2012 at The Stand Comedy Club in Edinburgh, and behind-the-scenes interviews.
title: The Alternative Comedy Experience

overview: Thee Chonlathorn, a confident and accomplished CEO, is thrown off balance when his loyal secretary of nine years, Preem Primala, unexpectedly resigns. As he seeks answers, their journey uncovers hidden emotions and truths that could change their lives forever.
title: Dear My Secretary

overview: Otherwords digs deep into this quintessential human trait of language and finds the fascinating, thought-provoking, and funny stories behind the words and sounds we take for granted. Incorporating the fields of biology, history, cultural studies, literature and more, linguistics has something for everyone and offers a unique perspective on what it means to be human
title: Otherwords

overview: Join hosts Michelle Barboza-Ramirez, Kallie Moore, and Blake de Pastino as they take you on a journey through the history of life on Earth. From the dawn of life in the Archaean Eon through the Mesozoic Era — the so-called "Age of Dinosaurs" -- right up to the end of the most recent Ice Age.
title: Eons

overview: Join Joe Hanson as he explores curiosity and illuminates the science behind… well, everything.
title: Be Smart

overview: In the Margins covers the history they didn't teach in school, exploring obscure, yet captivating tales that offer unique insights into their time and place.
title: In the Margins

overview: Cha Dae Woong is a spoiled brat with plans to become a successful action star. One day, on the run from his rich grandfather's latest fit of rage towards him, he accidentally frees a nine-tailed fox, Gu Mi Ho, who has been imprisoned in a painting for 500 years. Frightened at first, he runs away to the woods and ends up getting seriously injured. Feeling indebted to him, Gu Mi Ho gives him her " fox orb " a powerful part of her life force, to heal him. When he wakes up, the two form an awkward partnership, as Dae Woong begins to rely on the power of the orb to shoot his action sequences, while also giving in to Mi Ho's request to teach her how to act human. Though Dae Woong is initially acting out of fear, things start to change as he gradually begins to fall for her. However, Mi Ho will be faced with a terrible choice as her time in human form runs out in this heart-wrenching comedy.
title: My Girlfriend is a Gumiho

overview: Diggnation is back! Kevin Rose and Alex Albrecht give you their unique, sometimes awkward, and always hilarious take on the edges of the internet. Diggnation is a tech/web culture show based on the top digg.com social bookmarking news stories.
title: Diggnation

overview: The story of the life and sincere love of a real woman. The story begins with the twenty-year-old age of the main character, Irina. Then a great feeling settled in her kind heart, which she carried through many years of living together with her lover, who became Irina's husband. But time becomes a test for love, and not every man is able to appreciate devotion.
title: Солнечный зайчик
